queries: (ABSTRACT:"chlorpromazine" OR TITLE:"chlorpromazine") AND ABSTRACT:"occupancy" AND (ABSTRACT:PET OR ABSTRACT:SPECT OR ABSTRACT:"raclopride" OR ABSTRACT:"IBZM")

(TITLE:"chlorpromazine" OR ABSTRACT:"chlorpromazine") AND ABSTRACT:"D2" AND (ABSTRACT:"positron" OR ABSTRACT:SPECT OR ABSTRACT:"raclopride" OR ABSTRACT:"IBZM") AND (ABSTRACT:"patients" OR ABSTRACT:"volunteers")
note: Only rat/animal studies (Crocker 2001, Hemsley 1999) and pooled 'classical neuroleptics 65-85%' values (Farde 1988/1989). No human PET/SPECT study prints a chlorpromazine-specific occupancy with a stated dose.

queries: (ABSTRACT:"thioridazine" OR TITLE:"thioridazine") AND ABSTRACT:"occupancy" AND (ABSTRACT:PET OR ABSTRACT:SPECT OR ABSTRACT:"raclopride" OR ABSTRACT:"IBZM" OR ABSTRACT:"setoperone" OR ABSTRACT:"NMSP")
(TITLE:"thioridazine" OR ABSTRACT:"thioridazine") AND (ABSTRACT:"positron" OR ABSTRACT:SPECT OR ABSTRACT:"raclopride" OR ABSTRACT:"IBZM" OR ABSTRACT:"SCH23390")
note: No human PET/SPECT receptor-occupancy study found with a drug-specific value at a stated dose; hits were an animal EPS study and an unrelated cardiomyopathy paper.

queries: (ABSTRACT:"pimozide" OR TITLE:"pimozide") AND ABSTRACT:"occupancy" AND (ABSTRACT:PET OR ABSTRACT:SPECT OR ABSTRACT:"raclopride" OR ABSTRACT:"IBZM" OR ABSTRACT:"setoperone")
(ABSTRACT:"pimozide" OR TITLE:"pimozide") AND ABSTRACT:"occupancy"
TITLE:"pimozide"
(TITLE:"pimozide" OR ABSTRACT:"pimozide") AND (ABSTRACT:"raclopride" OR ABSTRACT:"IBZM" OR ABSTRACT:"spiperone" OR ABSTRACT:"NMSP")
note: No non-review human abstract found that prints a pimozide occupancy value with a stated dose.

queries: (ABSTRACT:"molindone" OR TITLE:"molindone") AND ABSTRACT:"occupancy" AND (ABSTRACT:PET OR ABSTRACT:SPECT OR ABSTRACT:"raclopride" OR ABSTRACT:"IBZM" OR ABSTRACT:"setoperone" OR ABSTRACT:"NMSP")
(ABSTRACT:"molindone" OR TITLE:"molindone") AND ABSTRACT:"occupancy"
note: No PET/SPECT occupancy abstract found for molindone.

queries: (ABSTRACT:"flupentixol" OR TITLE:"flupentixol") AND ABSTRACT:"occupancy" AND (ABSTRACT:PET OR ABSTRACT:SPECT OR ABSTRACT:"raclopride" OR ABSTRACT:"IBZM" OR ABSTRACT:"setoperone" OR ABSTRACT:"NMSP")
(ABSTRACT:"flupenthixol" OR TITLE:"flupenthixol") AND ABSTRACT:"occupancy" AND (ABSTRACT:PET OR ABSTRACT:SPECT OR ABSTRACT:"raclopride")
note: Only human finding (Farde 1992, PMID 1358126) reports D1 occupancy (36-44%) for flupenthixol, not D2 or 5-HT2A, and gives no mg dose. No usable D2/5-HT2A value with a dose.

queries: (ABSTRACT:"fluphenazine" OR TITLE:"fluphenazine") AND ABSTRACT:"occupancy" AND (ABSTRACT:PET OR ABSTRACT:SPECT OR ABSTRACT:"raclopride" OR ABSTRACT:"IBZM" OR ABSTRACT:"setoperone" OR ABSTRACT:"NMSP")
note: Only human PET study (Nyberg 1998, PMID 11281952) used fluphenazine DECANOATE depot (100-250 mg/wk IM), D2 89-97%, 5-HT2 76-105%. Excluded by depot/LAI rule (no oral daily mg dose).

queries: (ABSTRACT:"perphenazine" OR TITLE:"perphenazine") AND ABSTRACT:"occupancy" AND (ABSTRACT:PET OR ABSTRACT:SPECT OR ABSTRACT:"raclopride" OR ABSTRACT:"IBZM" OR ABSTRACT:"setoperone")
note: Only human PET study (Talvik 2004, PMID 15007534) used perphenazine DECANOATE depot and reports dose as serum nmol/l (not mg); D2 66-82%. Excluded by depot/LAI rule and no mg dose.

queries: (ABSTRACT:"zuclopenthixol" OR TITLE:"zuclopenthixol") AND ABSTRACT:"occupancy" AND (ABSTRACT:PET OR ABSTRACT:SPECT OR ABSTRACT:"raclopride" OR ABSTRACT:"IBZM" OR ABSTRACT:"setoperone" OR ABSTRACT:"NMSP")
note: Only human PET study (Nyberg 1995, PMID 8748043) used 12.5 mg zuclopenthixol acetate by intramuscular injection (D2 51-75% at 7h), not an oral daily dose. Excluded as injection data per oral-dose rule.

queries: (TITLE:"ziprasidone" OR ABSTRACT:"ziprasidone") AND ABSTRACT:"occupancy" AND (ABSTRACT:PET OR ABSTRACT:SPECT OR ABSTRACT:raclopride OR ABSTRACT:setoperone)
(TITLE:"ziprasidone" ...) AND ABSTRACT:"occupancy" AND ABSTRACT:"mg"
note: Candidate human PET studies found (Mamo 2004 PMID 15121646 D2 mean 56%/5-HT2 76% at 40-160 mg/day; Suzuki 2013 PMID 23417515 60 mg bid time-course 66/39/2% putamen; Vernaleken 2008 PMID 19011428 40 mg single dose) but in every abstract the oral dose and the occupancy value appear in separate, non-adjacent sentences (dose in Methods, pooled/time-course value in Results) so no <=2-sentence contiguous quote contains both dose and occupancy. Skipped per quote rule.

queries: (TITLE:"paliperidone" OR ABSTRACT:"paliperidone") AND ABSTRACT:"occupancy"
(TITLE:"paliperidone" OR ABSTRACT:"paliperidone" OR ABSTRACT:"9-hydroxyrisperidone") AND ABSTRACT:"occupancy" AND ABSTRACT:"mg"
note: Main oral study Arakawa 2008 (PMID 18058087): doses 3/9/15 mg/day in Methods, striatal occupancy range 54.2-85.5% in Results (non-adjacent, >2 sentences apart); the only dose+occupancy sentence ('paliperidone ER at 6-9 mg provides an estimated level ... between 70-80%') is an estimated/modeled value, excluded by the no-interpolation rule. Skipped.

queries: (TITLE:"olanzapine" OR ABSTRACT:"olanzapine") AND ABSTRACT:"occupancy" AND (ABSTRACT:setoperone OR ABSTRACT:altanserin OR ABSTRACT:NMSP)
note: Human 5-HT2A values exist but none with a contiguous dose: Kapur 1998 (PMID 9659858) 'near saturation ... even at 5 mg/day' gives no %; Kessler 2005 (PMID 16123775) 85-93% has no dose in abstract; Nyberg 1997 (PMID 8981383) 74/86/92% is >2 sentences from the 10 mg dose. Skipped.

queries: (TITLE:"quetiapine" ...) AND ABSTRACT:"occupancy" AND (ABSTRACT:raclopride OR ABSTRACT:IBZM)
note: Kapur 2000 (PMID 10839333, Arch Gen Psychiatry transient-occupancy study) reports 0%-27% (12h) and transient 58%-64% D2 but the dose range (150-600 mg/d) is in Methods, non-contiguous with the occupancy sentences; Kessler 2006 (PMID 16738543) putamen 33.5% has no mg dose. These were skipped; usable quetiapine D2/5-HT2A points taken from Gefvert 2001 (PMID 11313155).

queries: (ABSTRACT:"iloperidone" OR TITLE:"iloperidone") AND ABSTRACT:"occupancy"
(ABSTRACT:"iloperidone" OR ABSTRACT:"HP 873" OR ABSTRACT:"HP-873") AND (ABSTRACT:"occupancy" OR ABSTRACT:"PET" OR ABSTRACT:"positron" OR ABSTRACT:"SPECT")
note: No human PET/SPECT occupancy study found in Europe PMC abstracts (only radiolabelling, reviews, meta-analyses).

queries: (ABSTRACT:"pimavanserin" OR TITLE:"pimavanserin") AND ABSTRACT:"occupancy"
(ABSTRACT:"pimavanserin" OR ABSTRACT:"ACP-103" OR ABSTRACT:"ACP 103") AND (ABSTRACT:"occupancy" OR ABSTRACT:"PET" OR ABSTRACT:"positron")
note: Nordstrom 2008 (PMID 17708779, ACP-103, [11C]NMSP, single 1-100 mg) gives no numeric occupancy in abstract (only near-maximal displacement at 10-20 mg); Burstein 2026 (PMID 42677352) gives 41-100% range vs plasma concentration with no dose. Nucci 2009 not found with abstract occupancy values.

queries: (ABSTRACT:"lurasidone") AND (ABSTRACT:"occupancy") AND (ABSTRACT:"positron" OR ABSTRACT:"PET")
note: No human 5-HT2A data (marmoset study excluded). Potkin 2014 (PMID 24073841) D2 fallypride only states '>65% can be achieved across 80-160 mg/day' (not a group value), so skipped.

queries: (ABSTRACT:"cariprazine") AND (ABSTRACT:"occupancy") AND (ABSTRACT:"positron" OR ABSTRACT:"PET")
note: Only human study is Girgis 2016 (D2/D3 PHNO). Seneca 2011 is monkey.

queries: (ABSTRACT:"brexpiprazole") AND (ABSTRACT:"occupancy") AND (ABSTRACT:"positron" OR ABSTRACT:"PET")
note: Girgis 2020 abstract states 'robust and dose-related' 5-HT2A occupancy without numeric value.

queries: ABSTRACT:"aripiprazole" AND (ABSTRACT:"receptor occupancy" OR ABSTRACT:"raclopride" OR ABSTRACT:"fallypride" OR ABSTRACT:"IBZM" OR ABSTRACT:"FLB457" OR ABSTRACT:"PHNO" OR ABSTRACT:"setoperone" OR ABSTRACT:"MDL100907")
note: No SERT data. Excluded: Shin 2018/Kim 2022 (no dose), Mizrahi 2009 (no dose), Freudenmann 2010 case report (no dose), Grunder 2008 (EC50 only).

queries: (ABSTRACT:"asenapine" OR ABSTRACT:"Org 5222" OR ABSTRACT:"ORG-5222") AND (ABSTRACT:"occupancy" OR ABSTRACT:"positron" OR ABSTRACT:"SPECT")
note: Only Andree 1997 (ORG 5222 = asenapine, single sublingual 100 microgram) included; no human therapeutic-dose PET abstract found.

queries: (ABSTRACT:fluoxetine OR TITLE:fluoxetine) AND occupancy AND (serotonin transporter OR DASB OR McN5652 OR beta-CIT)
note: Meyer 2004 (15121647) reports 76-85% at minimum therapeutic dose but prints no numeric mg dose paired with a fluoxetine-specific occupancy; Kugaya 2004 (15450785) used fluoxetine 20 mg/day but prints no occupancy number. No contiguous dose+occupancy quote.

queries: (ABSTRACT:sertraline OR TITLE:sertraline) AND occupancy AND (serotonin transporter OR DASB)
note: Voineskos 2007 (17497139) ~85% at 'high therapeutic dose' with no mg number; Arakawa 2016 (27082864) 50 mg value is pooled with escitalopram; Parsey 2006 (16213473) prints 25-100 mg dose and 106.8% max occupancy but in non-contiguous sentences; Zitterl 2009 (19717141) 175 mg but no occupancy number. No valid contiguous quote.

queries: O-desmethylvenlafaxine / ODV AND occupancy AND DASB
note: Frankle 2018 (29216407) studied ODV (desvenlafaxine) at 25/50/100/150 mg but only reports the dose for 50% SERT occupancy (14.4 mg), i.e. an ED50-type value, no per-dose group occupancy printed. Skip per ED50-only rule.

queries: levomilnacipran AND occupancy
AUTH:Abanades AND occupancy
note: No human PET/SPECT SERT or NET occupancy study found. Abanades 2011 (20940733) is a duloxetine study, not levomilnacipran, and reports only OC50. Only preclinical/PK references available.

queries: vilazodone OR EMD 68843 AND occupancy
note: Rabiner 2000 (10962259) includes EMD 68843 (vilazodone) in a qualitative 5-HT1A [11C]WAY-100635 study but prints no vilazodone-specific dose or occupancy number ('none of the drugs achieved occupancies beyond 60%'). 5-HT1A is outside target set anyway. No SERT/5-HT2A data.

queries: (imipramine) AND occupancy AND (transporter OR PET OR SPECT)
note: No human PET/SPECT SERT occupancy study with a dose+occupancy value found.

queries: (amitriptyline) AND occupancy AND PET
note: No human PET/SPECT SERT occupancy study found. Lundberg 2012 (22243688) pooled TCAs (n=5) 28-86% without per-drug dose.

queries: nortriptyline AND occupancy AND (transporter OR PET)
note: Takano 2014 (24345533) reports only NET occupancy (50-70% at 75-200 mg/d) with [18F]FMeNER-D2; NET is outside target set. No SERT value.

queries: mirtazapine AND occupancy AND (5-HT2 OR MDL100907 OR setoperone)
note: Hinz 2007 (16685260) gives single oral 30 mg mirtazapine and 60% 5-HT2A occupancy but dose and occupancy are many sentences apart (not a <=2-sentence contiguous span). Lundberg 2012: mirtazapine did not occupy SERT. Smith 2007 (17653532) measures [11C]mirtazapine self-binding, not a standard target.

queries: trazodone AND occupancy AND (5-HT2 OR setoperone OR altanserin)
note: Only modeling/estimation papers (Settimo 2018 29332554, Oggianu 2022 35233913) that estimate occupancy from PK, not measured PET/SPECT. Skip.

queries: nefazodone AND occupancy
AUTH:Meyer JH AND setoperone
note: Meyer 1999 (10435395) single dose 200 mg nefazodone produced -39+/-17% change in 5-HT2A binding potential ([18F]setoperone PET), but the 200 mg dose and the -39% value are ~3 sentences apart (no contiguous <=2-sentence span) and the value is reported as BP change, not labeled occupancy. Skipped per quote rule.

queries: bupropion AND occupancy AND serotonin
note: Bupropion acts at DAT/NET (outside target set D2/DAT not needed; no clinically relevant SERT/5-HT2A). No human SERT/5-HT2A occupancy data point.

queries: buspirone AND occupancy AND 5-HT1A
note: Rabiner 2000 (10962259): buspirone was the one drug showing no measurable 5-HT1A occupancy; no dose/occupancy value. 5-HT1A outside target set; no SERT/5-HT2A data.

queries: agomelatine AND occupancy
agomelatine AND (PET OR receptor)
note: Agomelatine is an MT1/MT2 agonist and 5-HT2C antagonist; no human PET/SPECT receptor occupancy study (no 5-HT2A, SERT or D2 occupancy data) found.
